content.text:
- Improve the fullscreen feature to fully cover the viewport as expected. This is useful for interactive previews of the user's sketch. The current implementation is not working as expected
- When you click on an achievement badge on the dashboard ,allow the user to swipe left/right to see the next/prev achievements whilst the popup is active. Current implement has improper layout and the swipe is not working. Also remove the "How to Earn" section from it
- On the symbol reference pages, add a copy-to-clipboard button (reuse the logic from the exercise view's code editor) . Currently pressing the copy icon crashes the app. Also use the copy icon on the exercise view code block 
- Restrict the shake festure to just allow the user to report errors on all other routes and keep the exercise options in the modal as is and reduce the sensitivity

61:  switch (action.type) {

64:  case "LOAD_DONE": {

67:  const hasSetup = /function\s+setup\s*\(/.test(baseCode);

70:  ? 'function setup() {\n createCanvas(400, 400);\n}\n\nfunction draw() {\n background(20);\n}\n'
71:  : baseCode;
72:  return {
73:  ...state,
74:  loading: false,
75:  exercise: ex ? { ...ex, startingCode } : null,
76:  startingCode,
77:  code: startingCode,
78:  error: null,
79:  };
80:  }

83:  case "SET_CODE":

1: import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
2: import { Accelerometer } from "expo-sensors";
3: import * as Haptics from "expo-haptics";
4: 
5: const SHAKE_THRESHOLD = 3.5;
6: const SHAKE_COOLDOWN_MS = 1200;
7: const UPDATE_INTERVAL_MS = 50;
8: const WINDOW_SIZE = 3;
9: 
10: export function useShakeDetection(
11:   onShake: () => void,
12:   options?: { enabled?: boolean; haptic?: boolean }
13: ) {
14:   const { enabled = true, haptic = true } = options ?? {};
15:   const lastShakeRef = useRef(0);
16:   const historyRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; z: number }[]>([]);
17:   const onShakeRef = useRef(onShake);
18:   onShakeRef.current = onShake;
19: 
20:   const triggerShake = useCallback(() => {
21:     const now = Date.now();
22:     if (now - lastShakeRef.current < SHAKE_COOLDOWN_MS) return;
23:     lastShakeRef.current = now;
24:     if (haptic) {
25:       Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Medium).catch(() => {});
26:     }
27:     onShakeRef.current();
28:   }, [haptic]);
29: 
30:   useEffect(() => {
31:     if (!enabled) return;
32: 
33:     Accelerometer.setUpdateInterval(UPDATE_INTERVAL_MS);
34: 
35:     const subscription = Accelerometer.addListener((accelerometerData) => {
36:       const { x, y, z } = accelerometerData;
37:       const history = historyRef.current;
38: 
39:       history.push({ x, y, z });
40:       if (history.length > WINDOW_SIZE) {
41:         history.shift();
42:       }
43: 
44:       if (history.length < 2) return;
45: 
46:       const prev = history[history.length - 2];
47:       const deltaX = Math.abs(x - prev.x);
48:       const deltaY = Math.abs(y - prev.y);
49:       const deltaZ = Math.abs(z - prev.z);
50:       const magnitude = deltaX + deltaY + deltaZ;
51: 
52:       if (magnitude > SHAKE_THRESHOLD) {
53:         triggerShake();
54:       }
55:     });
56: 
57:     return () => {
58:       subscription.remove();
59:       historyRef.current = [];
60:     };
61:   }, [enabled, triggerShake]);
62: }

content.text:
Research complete. Here's my plan.

## Plan: 4 feature fixes

### 1. Fullscreen — truly cover the viewport
**Problem:** Current fullscreen only makes the main exercise WebView `position:absolute` inside the screen. Two flaws: (a) the WebView still shows the whole exercise page (description/solution/editor) — the sketch box only expands to 400px, so it's not an immersive preview; (b) root-level overlays (`SideDrawer` left-edge swipe strip `zIndex:30`, `DrawerFab` `zIndex:35`) sit above it, so it can never fully cover the viewport.

**Fix — native full-screen Modal with a dedicated preview WebView** (renders above everything, incl. drawer/status bar):
- New `src/utils/editor/fullscreenPreviewHtml.ts` — `getFullscreenPreviewHtml(code, colorScheme)` returns minimal HTML (p5 source, black `100vw×100vh` backdrop, canvas centered at its `createCanvas()` size per your choice, sketch wrapped like `exampleHtml.ts`, `describe()` stripped, error message rendered on failure).
- `src/app/learn/[course]/[id].tsx`:
  - Keep `fullscreen` state. On `toggleFullscreen` message → set `fullscreen` (hides keyboard).
  - Render `<Modal visible={fullscreen} presentationStyle="fullScreen" statusBarTranslucent>` + `<StatusBar hidden />` containing a fresh `<WebView source={{ html: getFullscreenPreviewHtml(state.code, scheme) }}>` (interactive) + existing exit close button overlay.
  - Delete the `fullscreenWebView` absolute styles; main WebView keeps `styles.webview`.
- `src/utils/editor/exerciseHtml.ts`: maximize button now only posts `toggleFullscreen` to RN (single source of truth); drop the `.expanded` toggle + icon sync in the WebView.

### 2. Achievement badge modal — working swipe + layout
**Problem:** `pageWidth = screenWidth - 48` (can exceed the card's `maxWidth: 420` on tablets/landscape) → item width ≠ card width ≠ `snapToInterval`, so paging breaks and layout is improper.

**Fix — rewrite `src/components/AchievementBadgeModal.tsx`:**
- `pageWidth = Math.min(screenWidth - 48, 420)` used consistently for card width, FlatList item width, `snapToInterval`, and `getItemLayout` so snap works on every device.
- Horizontal FlatList with `decelerationRate="fast"`, `disableIntervalMomentum`, `onMomentumScrollEnd` → update dots/current index.
- Keep dots indicator; hide when only one achievement; empty-state retained.
- "How to Earn" section is already removed in `620ef42` — verified gone, stays gone.

### 3. Copy-to-clipboard — ref pages + exercise code block icon
**Problem:** ref page copy uses an inline runtime `require("expo-clipboard")` that crashes on press; exercise editor's proven copy uses `navigator.clipboard` → `execCommand` fallback.

**Fix:**
- New shared `src/utils/clipboard.ts` — `copyToClipboard(text): Promise<boolean>` mirroring the exercise editor logic: native → static `import * as Clipboard from "expo-clipboard"` (fixes the inline `require` quirk) in try/catch; web → `navigator.clipboard.writeText` with hidden-textarea `execCommand` fallback. Returns success so UI only shows "Copied" on success.
- `src/app/ref/index.tsx`: rewire the existing Usage/syntax copy button to the util; **add copy buttons to each example code block** (inline icon + "Copy"/"Copied", same visual style).
- `src/utils/editor/exerciseHtml.ts`: upgrade the editor's Copy button to show a copy icon (inline SVG/unicode) + "Copy"/"Copied" text — "use the copy icon on the exercise view code block."

### 4. Shake — exercise options kept, report-error elsewhere, less sensitive
**Fix:**
- `src/hooks/useShakeDetection.ts`: `SHAKE_THRESHOLD` 3.5 → 5.5 and `SHAKE_COOLDOWN_MS` 1200 → 1500 (reduce sensitivity).
- Exercise `[id].tsx`: shake modal unchanged (Get Hint / Reset Code / View Reference / Dismiss).
- New `src/components/ReportErrorModal.tsx` (wraps `ShakeModal`): single "Report Error" action → `Linking.openURL("https://github.com/prjctimg/learn-p5/issues/new?title=...&body=...")` with app version (`APP_VERSION`) + current route/symbol pre-filled + a Dismiss action.

content.text:
All 4 fixes are done, verified (tsc/lint clean beyond pre-existing warnings), and released as **v0.7.6** (`ccd9d88` + tag `v0.7.6`, pushed to `main`).

**1. True fullscreen** — preview now opens in a native full-screen `Modal` with a black backdrop; the p5 canvas is centered at original size (no scaling). The WebView maximize button just notifies RN to toggle (`src/utils/editor/fullscreenPreviewHtml.ts`, `[id].tsx:917`).

**2. Achievement badge modal** — rewritten with proper horizontal paging, momentum-scrolled index tracking, and vertical dot indicators (`AchievementBadgeModal.tsx`).

**3. Copy-to-clipboard** — new shared `copyToClipboard` util (expo-clipboard native / `navigator.clipboard` → `execCommand` on web), wired into the reference page (syntax + each example block via a reusable `CopyButton`) and the exercise editor Copy button (now with icon + "Copied" feedback).

**4. Shake → report error** — shake now opens a "Report Error" modal on dashboard, settings, learn, tips, and reference routes, prefilling a GitHub issue with app version + route (`ReportErrorModal.tsx`). Exercise route keeps its hint/reset/reference actions. Sensitivity reduced (threshold 3.5→5.5, cooldown 1.2s→1.5s), and shake is gated by screen focus so stacked screens can't both fire.

Notes:
- Only pre-existing warnings/errors remain: two tsc errors (`onLoadStart` prop, `StatusBarAccent` "hidden") and lint warnings that were already at `dc713a6`; no new ones introduced.
- `expo-clipboard` is in `package.json`; the util uses the documented lazy-`require` pattern so it degrades gracefully if uninstalled.
Look at the codebase and prune dead code, modules and remove some of the uneeded or redundant scripts (which can be inlined directly into the workflows instead)

10: function slugToVarName(slug) {
11:   return slug.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, c) => c.toUpperCase()) + "Course";
12: }
13: 
14: const yamlFiles = fs
15:   .readdirSync(COURSES_DIR)
16:   .filter((f) => f.endsWith(".yaml") || f.endsWith(".yml"));
17: 
18: let count = 0;
19: 
20: for (const file of yamlFiles) {
21:   const yamlPath = path.join(COURSES_DIR, file);
22:   const raw = fs.readFileSync(yamlPath, "utf8");
23:   const data = jsyaml.load(raw);
24: 
25:   if (!data || !data.slug) {
26:     console.error(`  ✗ ${file}: missing "slug" field, skipping`);
27:     continue;
28:   }
29:

36:     `// Source: ${file}\n` +
37:     `export const ${varName} = ${jsonStr};\n`;
38: 
39:   fs.writeFileSync(tsPath, tsContent, "utf8");

1: #!/usr/bin/env node
2: // Fetches the latest published p5.js release and regenerates the vendored
3: // source artefacts:
4: //   - src/utils/p5Source.ts   (the minified p5 library as a string literal)
5: //   - src/utils/p5Version.ts  (the resolved version string)
6: //
7: // These files are gitignored build artefacts — regenerated on every fresh
8: // install and on `npm start` — so the app always bundles the newest p5.js.
9: // The format of p5Source.ts intentionally mirrors the original hand-authored
10: // shape (`const _p = [ ... ]; export const p5Source = _p.join("")`).
11: 
12: import fs from "fs";
13: import https from "https";
14: import path from "path";
15: import { fileURLToPath } from "url";
16: 
17: const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
18: const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
19: const P5_SOURCE_FILE = path.join(ROOT, "src/utils/p5Source.ts");
20: const P5_VERSION_FILE = path.join(ROOT, "src/utils/p5Version.ts");
21: 
22: function fetchText(url, redirects = 0) {
23:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
24:     if (redirects > 10) return reject(new Error("Too many redirects"));
25:     https.get(url, { headers: { "User-Agent": "learn-p5-bundler" } }, (res) => {
26:       if (res.statusCode >= 300 && res.statusCode < 400 && res.headers.location) {
27:         res.resume();
28:         return resolve(fetchText(res.headers.location, redirects + 1));
29:       }
30:       if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
31:         res.resume();
32:         return reject(new Error(`HTTP ${res.statusCode} for ${url}`));
33:       }
34:       const chunks = [];
35:       res.setEncoding("utf8");
36:       res.on("data", (c) => chunks.push(c));
37:       res.on("end", () => resolve(chunks.join("")));
38:       res.on("error", reject);
39:     }).on("error", reject);
40:   });
41: }
42: 
43: async function getLatestVersion() {
44:   const txt = await fetchText("https://registry.npmjs.org/p5/latest");
45:   const data = JSON.parse(txt);
46:   if (!data.version) throw new Error("No version field in npm registry response");
47:   return data.version;
48: }
49: 
50: function escapeForDoubleQuotedString(s) {
51:   // We emit the source as a JS double-quoted string literal. Escape in an
52:   // order that avoids double-escaping: backslashes first, then real control
53:   // chars that would otherwise break the literal across lines, then quotes.
54:   return s
55:     .replace(/\\/g, "\\\\")
56:     .replace(/\r/g, "\\r")
57:     .replace(/\n/g, "\\n")
58:     .replace(/"/g, '\\"');
59: }
60: 
61: // Split the (potentially huge) minified source into a few array elements so
62: // the generated file stays diff-friendly and avoids pathological single-line
63: // lengths that choke some tooling.
64: function chunkSource(src, chunkSize = 200_000) {
65:   const chunks = [];
66:   for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i += chunkSize) {
67:     chunks.push(src.slice(i, i + chunkSize));
68:   }
69:   return chunks;
70: }
71: 
72: function writeP5Source(version, src) {
73:   const escaped = chunkSource(src).map((c) => `"${escapeForDoubleQuotedString(c)}"`);
74:   const body = escaped.join(",\n  ");
75:   const file =
76:     `// AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/bundle-p5.mjs — do not edit directly.\n` +
77:     `// p5.js v${version} — fetched from the npm registry (latest) at build time.\n` +
78:     `// Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@${version}/lib/p5.min.js\n\n` +
79:     `const _p = [\n  ${body}\n];\n\n` +
80:     `export const p5Source: string = _p.join("");\n`;
81:   fs.writeFileSync(P5_SOURCE_FILE, file, "utf-8");
82: }
83: 
84: function writeP5Version(version) {
85:   const file =
86:     `// AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/bundle-p5.mjs — do not edit directly.\n` +
87:     `export const p5Version = "${version}";\n`;
88:   fs.writeFileSync(P5_VERSION_FILE, file, "utf-8");
89: }
90: 
91: async function main() {
92:   const version = await getLatestVersion();
93:   console.log(`[bundle-p5] Latest p5.js version: ${version}`);
94:   const url = `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@${version}/lib/p5.min.js`;
95:   console.log(`[bundle-p5] Fetching ${url}`);
96:   const src = await fetchText(url);
97:   if (!src || src.length < 100_000) {
98:     throw new Error(`Fetched p5 source looks empty/too small (${src?.length ?? 0} bytes)`);
99:   }
100:   writeP5Source(version, src);
101:   writeP5Version(version);
102:   console.log(`[bundle-p5] Wrote ${P5_SOURCE_FILE} (${src.length} bytes)`);
103:   console.log(`[bundle-p5] Wrote ${P5_VERSION_FILE}`);
104: }
105: 
106: main().catch((err) => {
107:   console.error("[bundle-p5] FAILED:", err);
108:   process.exit(1);
109: });

17: function stripIgnored(src) {
18:   let out = "";
19:   let i = 0;
20:   const n = src.length;
21:   while (i < n) {
22:     const c = src[i], c2 = src[i + 1];
23:     if (c === "/" && c2 === "/") { while (i < n && src[i] !== "\n") i++; continue; }
24:     if (c === "/" && c2 === "*") { i += 2; while (i < n && !(src[i] === "*" && src[i + 1] === "/")) i++; i += 2; continue; }
25:     if (c === '"' || c === "'" || c === "`") {
26:       const q = c; out += c; i++;
27:       while (i < n) {
28:         if (src[i] === "\\") { out += src[i]; if (i + 1 < n) out += src[i + 1]; i += 2; continue; }
29:         if (src[i] === q) { out += src[i]; i++; break; }
30:         out += src[i]; i++;
31:       }
32:       continue;
33:     }
34:     out += c; i++;
35:   }
36:   return out;
37: }
38: 
39: function findCallsByName(code, name) {
40:   const sanitized = stripIgnored(code);
41:   const calls = [];
42:   const re = new RegExp("\\b" + name + "\\b", "g");
43:   const idxs = [];
44:   let m;
45:   while ((m = re.exec(sanitized)) !== null) idxs.push(m.index + m[0].length);
46:   for (const start of idxs) {
47:     let i = start;
48:     while (i < sanitized.length && sanitized[i] !== "(") i++;
49:     if (sanitized[i] !== "(") continue;
50:     let depth = 0, argStart = i + 1; const args = [];
51:     for (let j = i; j < sanitized.length; j++) {
52:       const ch = sanitized[j];
53:       if (ch === "(") depth++;
54:       else if (ch === ")") {
55:         depth--;

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Pre-push git hook (see AGENTS.md "Release cadence").
# Refuses a push to main unless the pushed commit range includes a version bump
# in package.json AND a matching vX.Y.Z tag exists locally.
#
# Reads stdin: <local ref> <local sha> <remote ref> <remote sha> per line.

set -e

while read -r local_ref local_sha remote_ref remote_sha; do
  # Only enforce on the main branch.
  if [[ "$local_ref" != "refs/heads/main" ]]; then
    continue
  fi

  # Resolve the range of commits being pushed.
  if [[ -z "$remote_sha" || "$remote_sha" == "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]]; then
    range="$local_sha"
  else
    range="$remote_sha..$local_sha"
  fi

  repo_dir="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

  # Detect a version bump in package.json within the pushed range.
  bumped_version=""
  if git diff --name-only "$range" -- "$repo_dir/package.json" 2>/dev/null | grep -q package.json; then
    bumped_version=$(git show "$local_sha:package.json" 2>/dev/null | node -e "
      let data='';
      process.stdin.on('data',c=>data+=c);
      process.stdin.on('end',()=>{
        try { process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(data).version || ''); }
        catch(e) { process.stdout.write(''); }
      });
    ")
  fi

  if [[ -z "$bumped_version" ]]; then
    echo "[pre-push] ERROR: push to main must include a version bump in package.json." >&2
    echo "           Run: sh scripts/bump-version.sh <X.Y.Z>  then commit, then:" >&2
    echo "           git tag vX.Y.Z  before pushing." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  # Confirm the matching tag exists locally.
  if ! git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/v$bumped_version" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[pre-push] ERROR: package.json is at $bumped_version but tag v$bumped_version does not exist locally." >&2
    echo "           Run: git tag v$bumped_version  before pushing." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

exit 0

>

An offline first mobile app to help users learn p5.js through small (bite sized 🍣) exercises. It is not a replacement for the p5 web editor which has far more comprehensive editing features.

This is a [GSoC 2026](https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com/programs/2026/projects/wmrV9qBT) project for the [Processing Foundation](https://processingfoundation.org).

## What is this ?

Learn P5 is a mobile app to help users learn how p5.js symbols (functions, classes, built-in variables) work by showing users their sketch preview during the exercise. It is not a replacement for the p5 web editor which has far more comprehensive editing features.

This is a [GSoC 2026](https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com/programs/2026/projects/wmrV9qBT) project for the [Processing Foundation](https://processingfoundation.org).

## Who is this for ?

This app is intended for anyone who wants to learn p5.js at a relaxed pace that covers how each symbol works on the go, even without an internet connection to load resources such as the reference or web editor.

## How can I try it out ?

The app is currently available on Android only and ChromeOS if you are on the `dev` branch.

You can [grab the latest release here](https://github.com/skchr/learn-p5/releases/tag/latest)

## Where can I see and share suggestions ?

There's a few GitHub Discussions that are open to suggestions and where we post feature previews (screenshots and the like).

More threads will be created as the project progresses:

The exercise-level `solution` represents the FINAL task's target state.

7: ## Course modules (YAML → TS build artifacts)
8: 
9: - **Source of truth: `src/data/courses/*.yaml`** — edit YAML, never the `.ts` files.
10: - `scripts/build-courses.mjs` reads every `.yaml` in `src/data/courses/` and emits a matching `.ts` next to it (`<slug>Course` export).
11: - `build-courses` runs automatically via `postinstall` (so a fresh clone is buildable) and via `npm start` (so local edits propagate). CI's release workflow runs it explicitly after `npm install`.
12: - **`src/data/courses/*.ts` are gitignored build artifacts** (see `.gitignore`, same convention as `src/data/reference.generated.json`). Never commit them.
13: - `expo-clipboard` is used for copy-to-clipboard on symbol reference pages. Add it to `package.json` if the feature requires it (already present as of v0.7.4). Type declarations live in `src/types/expo-clipboard.d.ts`.

It runs as the first step of `postinstall` and `npm start` so the dependency is always available after a build. The import in `src/app/ref/index.tsx` uses try-catch `require` so it degrades gracefully if the package isn't installed.
15: - After editing any `.yaml`, re-run `npm run build-courses` before type-checking or starting the app.

18: 
19: - `scripts/bundle-p5.mjs` queries the npm registry for the latest `p5` release, downloads `lib/p5.min.js`, and regenerates `src/utils/p5Source.ts` (the vendored minified source as `const _p = [...]; export const p5Source = _p.join("")`) plus `src/utils/p5Version.ts` (`export const p5Version = "X.Y.Z"`).
